descriptionChirho: A division of a people based on descent from a common ancestor, especially the twelve tribes of Israel; used extensively in Revelation for the eschatological gathering (Rev 5:9, 7:4-9, 11:9, 13:7, 14:6) and in references to specific Israelite tribes (Luke 2:36 tribe of Asher; Phil 3:5 tribe of Benjamin; Heb 7:13-14 tribe of Judah). Singular and plural forms are purely number inflection. Multilingual evidence is uniform: Spanish 'tribu(s)', Arabic 'سِبط/قَبائِل/أسباط', Korean '지파(들)', Swahili 'kabila/makabila', Hindi 'गोत्र/गोत्रों'.
